title: Add periodic supervisor dry-run mode

per_symbol_behavior.AT: OPEN_LIMIT visible but policy-blocked by close-only allow_open=false; ignored by supervisor.
per_symbol_behavior.ADA: No actionable candidate; enabled_for_live=false scan-only symbol.
per_symbol_behavior.BTC: No actionable candidate; enabled_for_live=false scan-only symbol.
per_symbol_behavior.ETH: No actionable candidate; enabled_for_live=false scan-only symbol.
per_symbol_behavior.SOL: No current CLOSE_READY candidate after successful SOL LONG harvest; supervisor waits.

summary: Added read-only supervisor_dry_run mode that scans allowlisted symbols, filters only safe CLOSE_LIMIT reduce-only qty=1 candidates, reports one possible manual next step, and never writes queue or submits. Current live state returns WAIT because no close-ready candidate remains after the successful SOL harvest.
